E1335

An environment integration, package-generation provider fact, or executable lease handoff is conflicting, lossy, or invalid

What

An environment integration, package-generation provider fact, or executable lease handoff is conflicting, lossy, or invalid

Why

Integrations and package generations lower into shared typed facts; an executable child may use only a verified leased output, so a path that escapes the lease or a failed handoff cannot run.

Fix

Merge the declarations, use a supported package ref, or re-realize the package so Jetpack can hand only its verified lease to the child.
